citations.quote: In this section, we define comparative advantage, distinguish it from the notion of absolute advantage, and demonstrate the gains from trading in accordance with comparative advantage.
9.1 Balance of Payments Accounts The BOP is a double-entry system in which every transaction involves both a debit and credit.
